_comment: Deterministic per-edit checks for the Anthropic security-guidance plugin. JSON form loads on any Python (no PyYAML needed). Additive to the plugin's built-in patterns. Reminders cap at 1 KB; up to 50 rules loaded.

patterns.reminder: Possible hardcoded credential. Load from edge-function env or EAS server env, never from app source or committed config.
Service-role key or usage in client code. The service-role key bypasses RLS and must never ship in the app bundle. Move this to an edge function.
DOM injection sink. Escape or sanitize user-derived content before it reaches this sink; prefer text nodes.
Never write auth.users directly. Use GoTrue signup or the admin API.
Email or notification recipient taken from the request. Restrict to the authenticated user's own verified address.
Auth-flow navigation must use router.replace(), not push(), to prevent back-nav into a half-authenticated state.
